description: Durable, user-controlled project memory and cross-agent continuity for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: XMemo gives ChatGPT and Codex a private, user-controlled workspace for decisions, project context, approved plans, TODOs, progress checkpoints, and handoffs. Eight professional skills help brainstorm, plan, review, audit, distill, resume, and transfer work while keeping compatible AI agents aligned through the same durable context.
defaultPrompt: Bring me up to speed on my current project.
Save the decisions and next actions from this conversation.
Review this plan against what we previously decided.

publication.release_notes: XMemo 1.0.2 adds seven focused workflows alongside Memory Steward: brainstorm, plan, review, audit, distill, resume, and handoff. Reuses the existing authenticated MCP connection without a ZIP auth override; includes validated reproducible packaging.
